name: HKCanto-Eval
description: The ability of language models to comprehend and interact in diverse linguistic and cultural landscapes is crucial. The Cantonese language used in Hong Kong presents unique challenges for natural language processing due to its rich cultural nuances and lack of dedicated evaluation datasets. The HKCanto-Eval benchmark addresses this gap by evaluating the performance of large language models (LLMs) on Cantonese language understanding tasks, extending to English and Written Chinese for cross-lingual evaluation. HKCanto-Eval integrates cultural and linguistic nuances intrinsic to Hong Kong, providing a robust framework for assessing language models in realistic scenarios. Additionally, the benchmark includes questions designed to tap into the underlying linguistic metaknowledge of the models. reputation: A recent benchmark for Cantonese and Hong Kong cultural-linguistic understanding that is still emerging rather than broadly standardized.
notes: May be sensitive to cultural and linguistic contamination from pretraining; performance can vary substantially across Cantonese, English, and Written Chinese subsets.
